arxiv-2104-01721.title: Citrinet: Closing the Gap between Non-Autoregressive and Autoregressive End-to-End Models for Automatic Speech Recognition
arxiv-2104-01721.creator: Somshubra Majumdar, Jagadeesh Balam, Oleksii Hrinchuk, Vitaly Lavrukhin, Vahid Noroozi, Boris Ginsburg
arxiv-2104-01721.description: Abstract We propose Citrinet - a new end-to-end convolutional Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) based automatic speech recognition (ASR) model. Citrinet is deep residual neural model which uses 1D time-channel separable convolutions combined with sub-word encoding and squeeze-and-excitation. The resulting architecture significantly reduces the gap between non-autoregressive and sequence-to-sequence and transducer models.

arxiv-2204-04602.title: How much can one learn a partial differential equation from its solution?
arxiv-2204-04602.creator: Yuchen He, Hongkai Zhao, Yimin Zhong
arxiv-2204-04602.description: Abstract . In this work, we study the problem of learning a partial differential equation (PDE) from its solution data. PDEs of various types are used to illustrate how much the solution data can reveal the PDE operator depending on the underlying operator and initial data.

arxiv-2206-13734.title: H-GCN: A Graph Convolutional Network Accelerator on Versal ACAP Architecture
arxiv-2206-13734.creator: Chengming Zhang ⋆ 5, Tong Geng 2 4, Anqi Guo 3, Jiannan Tian ⋆, Martin Herbordt 3, Ang Li 2, Dingwen Tao ⋆ 5
arxiv-2206-13734.description: Abstract Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have drawn tremendous attention due to their unique capability to extend Machine Learning (ML) approaches to applications broadly-defined as having unstructured data, especially graphs. Compared with other Machine Learning (ML) modalities, the acceleration of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) is more challenging due to the irregularity and heterogeneity derived from graph typologies.

arxiv-2207-09259.title: Adaptive Testing for Connected and Automated Vehicles with Sparse Control Variates in Overtaking Scenarios
arxiv-2207-09259.creator: Jingxuan Yang, Honglin He, Yi Zhang, Shuo Feng, and Henry X. Liu
arxiv-2207-09259.description: Abstract Testing and evaluation is a critical step in the development and deployment of connected and automated vehicles (CAVs). Due to the black-box property and various types of CAVs, how to test and evaluate CAVs adaptively remains a major challenge. Many approaches have been proposed to adaptively generate testing scenarios during the testing process.

arxiv-2304-10062.title: Wong–Zakai approximation of regime-switching SDEs via rough path theory
arxiv-2304-10062.creator: Jasper Barr, Giang T. Nguyen, Oscar Peralta
arxiv-2304-10062.description: Abstract This paper investigates the convergence of Wong–Zakai approximations to regime-switching stochastic differential equations, generated by a collection of finite-variation approximations to Brownian motion. pmc-11336502.title: A Quarter-Century of Online Informatics Education: Learners Served and Lessons Learned
pmc-11336502.creator: William Hersh, Gunther Eysenbach, Cynthia Lokker, Jing Xia
pmc-11336502.description: The value and methods of online learning have changed tremendously over the last 25 years. pmc-11368714.title: GnRH agonist-only trigger, compared to dual trigger, reduces oocyte retrieval rate in high responders without affecting cumulative live birth rate
